$comment: SHRINK-ONLY RATCHET, measured in CI (never locally - the tool's governed suite depends on the repo-root install). Every entry is a KNOWN failure that predates this CI job; the job is advisory only while this file is non-empty. Fails in BOTH directions: a new failure REDs at once, a fixed one REDs until its entry is removed. When both maps are empty, drop `continue-on-error` from .github/workflows/graph-evaluator.yml and promote the job to a required check.
